integrity: All-length proof explicitly separates combinatorial collision alignment from finite computational checks; no independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exponential full-shadow probability is conditioned on cyclically proper indexed words over fixed q>=3, rather than arbitrary random words.
The upper bound on the exceptional fraction is not claimed sharp and no closed finite-length formula for all maximal words is proved.
Exactly one symbol is deleted and the output is identified only under cyclic rotation, not reversal or relabeling.
Historical priority cannot be guaranteed against unindexed equivalent necklace-shadow results.
title: Full one-deletion shadows of nonbinary necklaces are exponentially typical among proper circles
